project.name: IronVault
project.description: Encrypted AI/ML model management system with versioning, 23+ format conversion, compliance validation (FIPS 140-3, CMMC 2.0, MITRE ATT&CK), RAG with MCP tools, federation, blockchain audit, model download (HuggingFace/Ollama/URL), HMAC signing & verification, pickle safety scanning, tensor-level diffing, engine interop (Ollama/LM Studio), license scanning, model tags & search, vault export/import, garbage collection, TUI dashboard, webhooks, role-based ACL, KMS integration, model validation, retention policies, cross-model lineage DAG, plugin system, config profiles, quantization pipeline, evaluation harness, backup scheduling, and multi-vault management.

agent_interfaces.description: Command-line interface with 42+ subcommands for vault, model, cloud, database, quantization, evaluation, backup, multi-vault, and utility operations. Use `iv introspect` for machine-readable CLI schema discovery.

exit_codes.6: Invalid input, including a mistyped subcommand or flag

environment_variables.name: IRONVAULT_HOME
environment_variables.description: Relocates all config/data/cache directories under one root

environment_variables.name: IRONVAULT_PASSPHRASE
environment_variables.description: Vault passphrase for automation: literal value or KMS URI (env://, file://, aws-sm://, azure-kv://, vault://)

environment_variables.name: AZURE_STORAGE_SAS_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Azure SAS token. Shared keys (AZURE_STORAGE_KEY) are not supported: the Azure SDK for Rust v1 has no shared-key credential

environment_variables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
environment_variables.description: Azure Entra ID tenant, as an alternative to a SAS token

environment_variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environment_variables.description: OTLP collector endpoint (requires the otel feature). Setting it does not enable telemetry

agent_interfaces.description: Model Context Protocol server with built-in tools spanning vault lifecycle, model conversion, signing, scanning, diffing, quantization, evaluation, backup, multi-vault, RAG, ACL, policies, lineage-graph, plugins, profiles, webhooks, GC, validation, and license scanning. Extensible via ToolRegistry.
REST API powered by Axum with JWT authentication. Requires `api` cargo feature.
GraphQL API powered by async-graphql. Requires `graphql` cargo feature.
Rust crate with public API for embedding in Rust applications.
Python bindings via PyO3. Requires `python` cargo feature.

model_management.description: Store, retrieve, version, and delete AI models with full encryption
model_management.versioning: Sequential with parent lineage and branching

encryption.description: Military-grade encryption for all stored models

format_conversion.description: Convert models between 23+ formats with optional quantization

compliance.description: Automated compliance validation against industry standards

cloud_storage.description: Push/pull models to cloud providers. Uploads are sealed client-side with AES-256-GCM (Argon2id key from the vault passphrase, fresh salt per object), so the bucket holds ciphertext. Objects pushed before 4.3.0 are plaintext and are accepted with a warning.

rag.description: Retrieval Augmented Generation system for AI-powered document search

model_cards.description: Structured model documentation following Google/HuggingFace standards

utilities.description: Archive, analyze, deduplicate, and export models

federation.description: Sync vaults across peers with vector clocks and conflict resolution. Opt-in via federation.enabled; transfers are sealed client-side with AES-256-GCM by default. Peers authenticate with a shared X-API-Key, not the API's JWT.

blockchain_audit.description: Append-only blockchain audit trail with Merkle tree proofs. Opt-in via security.blockchain_audit; mirrors every audit-log entry into a hash-linked chain. Read-only from the CLI — entries are recorded by the audit logger, never by a command.

agent_discovery.description: Machine-readable CLI schema introspection for AI agent bootstrapping

quantization.description: Quantization pipeline with profile management and size estimation

evaluation.description: Model evaluation harness for recording and comparing benchmark results

backup_scheduling.description: Automated vault backup scheduling with configurable intervals

multi_vault.description: Multi-vault registry for managing and switching between multiple vaults

model_download.description: Download models from HuggingFace Hub, Ollama registry, or arbitrary URLs with SHA-256 verification

model_signing.description: HMAC-SHA256 signatures with detached .sig files for provenance
model_signing.rest_note: The REST surface signs stored vault bytes and returns the detached signature inline; it does not read or write caller-named filesystem paths.

safety_scanning.description: Detect dangerous pickle opcodes and patterns in PyTorch/pickle files

model_diffing.description: Compare model versions at the tensor level (SafeTensors, GGUF, generic byte-level)
model_diffing.rest_note: Operands are `name` or `name@version`, resolved against the vault. Filesystem paths are rejected.

engine_interop.description: Register models with local inference engines

benchmarks.description: Store and query benchmark results per model version

license_scanning.description: Detect licenses from model cards, config.json, GGUF metadata, LICENSE files (SPDX-normalized)
license_scanning.rest_note: Scans a model held in the vault, addressed by name. The REST surface does not accept a filesystem path.

tags_and_search.description: Tag models with labels and annotations, search by name/tags/annotations

vault_bundle.description: Portable gzipped-tar vault bundles with selective model export
vault_bundle.rest_note: Export streams the bundle in the response body and import reads it from the request body; neither takes a server-side path.

garbage_collection.description: Orphaned blob detection, temp file cleanup, and space reclaim with dry-run support

tui_dashboard.description: Terminal UI dashboard for browsing vault contents

webhooks.description: HTTP notification system integrated with the EventSubscriber bus

kms_integration.description: Fetch secrets from external secrets managers

model_validation.description: Integrity probes with SHA-256 checksums per model version

retention_policies.description: Configurable max versions/age/minimum with dry-run enforcement

lineage_graph.description: Cross-model lineage as a directed acyclic graph tracking derivation chains

plugin_system.description: Discover, install, uninstall plugins with JSON manifests

config_profiles.description: Named configuration profiles with activate/deactivate switching

telemetry.description: Anonymous, opt-in telemetry honouring DO_NOT_TRACK and IRONVAULT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED

use_cases: Secure model storage for regulated industries (defense, healthcare, finance)
Model version control and lineage tracking for ML teams
Format conversion for edge/mobile deployment (GGUF, TFLite, CoreML)
RAG-powered knowledge base for model documentation
Federated model sync across distributed teams
Local LLM serving pipeline (store → convert to GGUF → serve via Ollama)
